solver_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(a.player_id) AS N FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN all_star AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(N) AS M FROM counts), first_kept AS (SELECT c.N, c.N - m.M AS difference FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE c.N > m.M), mean_difference AS (SELECT AVG(difference) AS D FROM first_kept) SELECT SUM(f.N) AS total_N, AVG(f.difference) AS average_N_minus_M, AVG(f.difference - d.D) AS average_final_difference FROM first_kept AS f CROSS JOIN mean_difference AS d WHERE f.difference > d.D

WITH country_rates AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS R FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON CAST(v.player_id AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS T FROM country_rates) SELECT c.death_country, c.R, c.R / o.T FROM country_rates AS c JOIN overall AS o ON o.T IS NOT NULL

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.city_id, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count FROM city AS c LEFT JOIN address AS a ON a.city_id = c.city_id GROUP BY c.city_id), city_average AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_count FROM city_counts), eligible AS (SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, cc.address_count / ca.avg_count AS relative_to_average FROM city_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN city_average AS ca WHERE ca.avg_count IS NOT NULL), total AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_count FROM eligible) SELECT e.city_id, e.address_count, e.relative_to_average, 1.0 * e.address_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total FROM eligible AS e CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_of_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH film_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), count_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM film_counts), kept AS (SELECT fc.film_id, fc.actor_count, fc.actor_count - ca.avg_count AS excess FROM film_counts AS fc JOIN count_average AS ca ON fc.actor_count > ca.avg_count), excess_average AS (SELECT AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.actor_count, k.excess, k.excess - ea.avg_excess AS second_excess FROM kept AS k JOIN excess_average AS ea ON k.excess > ea.avg_excess) SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS total_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM remaining

WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.order_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS A FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.A, p.A - overall.B AS A_minus_B FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.B IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.A - overall.B DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(li.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS R, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS S FROM invoice_averages) SELECT ia.invoice_number, ia.R, ia.line_count, ia.R / overall.S AS ratio_to_S FROM invoice_averages AS ia CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.S IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_to_S IS NULL, ratio_to_S DESC LIMIT 10

WITH item_averages AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS P, AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town_city), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(P) AS Q FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town_city, t.P, t.avg_cost_ratio, t.P - q.Q AS price_difference FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS q WHERE q.Q IS NOT NULL AND t.P > q.Q

WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), ratios AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, CAST(invoice_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS r FROM invoice_counts), scored AS (SELECT invoice_count, r, AVG(r) OVER () AS m FROM ratios) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoice_count, AVG(r) AS average_r, AVG(r - m) AS average_r_minus_m FROM scored WHERE r > m

WITH counts AS (SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id), shares AS (SELECT line_count, 1.0 * line_count / NULLIF(SUM(line_count) OVER (), 0) AS R FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT line_count, R, AVG(R) OVER () AS M FROM shares) SELECT SUM(line_count) AS total_line_count, AVG(R) AS average_R, AVG(R - M) AS average_R_minus_M FROM compared WHERE R > M

WITH pair AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS M, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.balance END) AS B FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region AS (SELECT region_name, AVG(M) AS RM, AVG(B) AS RB FROM pair GROUP BY region_name), global AS (SELECT AVG(RM) AS G FROM region) SELECT region.region_name, region.RM, region.RB, region.RM / global.G AS ratio FROM region CROSS JOIN global WHERE global.G IS NOT NULL

WITH counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS N FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(N) AS T, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM counts) SELECT SUM(c.N), AVG(1.0 * c.N / t.T), AVG(1.0 * c.N / t.T - 1.0 / t.account_count) FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * c.N / t.T > 1.0 / t.account_count

WITH step1 AS (SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / (l.HCT / 100.0)) AS avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction) AS benchmark FROM step1) SELECT s.patient_id, s.sex, s.avg_wbc, s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction, s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction - b.benchmark AS difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction > b.benchmark ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB / (HCT / 100.0)) AS avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.avg_pic, s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction, s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction - t.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS t ON t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE s.avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction > t.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_pic), AVG(avg_hgb_per_hct_fraction), AVG(difference) FROM step3

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS albumin_minus_protein, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(albumin_minus_protein) AS albumin_minus_protein, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(albumin_minus_protein) AS m FROM sex_averages) SELECT AVG(s.albumin_minus_protein), AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt), AVG(s.albumin_minus_protein - o.m) FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.albumin_minus_protein > o.m

WITH patient_r AS (SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT / 100.0, 0)) AS R FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS M1 FROM patient_r), kept AS (SELECT r.ID, r.R, r.R - o.M1 AS D1 FROM patient_r AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.R > o.M1), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS M2 FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.R), AVG(k.D1), AVG(k.R - m.M2) FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.R > m.M2

WITH per_race AS (SELECT cs.raceId, c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cs.raceId, c.country), per_country AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) AS A, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM per_race GROUP BY country), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM per_country) SELECT pc.country, pc.A, pc.avg_wins, pc.A - b.B AS difference FROM per_country AS pc JOIN baseline AS b ON b.B IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transaction_id, t.tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_option_volume) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.transaction_id, step1.trader_type, step1.avg_option_volume, step1.avg_option_volume - step2.overall_avg AS deviation FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT trader_type, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.trader_type, step3.avg_option_volume, step3.deviation, step3.deviation - step4.type_avg_deviation AS excess_deviation FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step3.trader_type = step4.trader_type COLLATE BINARY WHERE step3.deviation > step4.type_avg_deviation) SELECT trader_type, AVG(avg_option_volume), AVG(deviation), AVG(excess_deviation) FROM step5 GROUP BY trader_type

WITH counts AS (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS t FROM counts), ratios AS (SELECT c.ordervault, c.record_count, CAST(c.record_count AS REAL) / t.t AS r FROM counts AS c INNER JOIN total AS t ON t.t IS NOT NULL), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS y FROM ratios) SELECT SUM(r.record_count) AS total_count, AVG(r.r) AS average_r, AVG(r.r - a.y) AS average_d FROM ratios AS r INNER JOIN average_ratio AS a ON a.y IS NOT NULL WHERE r.r > a.y
